summary: Plan smallholder value-chain upgrades, aggregation and buyer links. Build practical maps and action plans; explore the course.
lede: Smallholder value chain development links farm production with buyer requirements and services. For extension officers, producer-organization staff and agribusiness advisers, the course builds practical skills in mapping product and payment flows, diagnosing bottlenecks with the Sustainable Food Value Chain framework, and assessing producer-group capacity. Participants also plan aggregation, buyer linkages and post-harvest improvements using food-hygiene principles, and outline monitoring measures for validating upgrades with chain actors.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who coordinate smallholder production, producer organizations, market access and services, and who need to turn field findings into feasible value-chain plans.
modules: Buyer Linkages, Services and Risk Plans
prerequisites: Prior work supporting smallholder farmers, producer organizations or agricultural market-development activities is expected. You should be able to contribute field observations or a familiar value-chain example; no coding or programming is required.
